breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting instructions for the time integration method. The original prompt listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'IMEX Euler OR Strang splitting'. The agent correctly discarded the simple 'Explicit forward Euler' and chose one of the valid, more complex options ('Strang splitting'), which is consistent with the ground truth's resolution of removing the contradictory instruction.
